privacy: Never commit actual holdings, quantities, cost basis, order IDs, bank balances, or broker files to this public repository.
warnings: A market-risk alert is not an automatic command to sell all positions.
Never issue a broker order or fabricate order status or prices.
If market observations are stale, classify UNVERIFIED, not NORMAL.
Include an execution deadline for every HOLD/KEEP recommendation.
This module is deterministic and does not fetch prices. The scheduled ChatGPT task must obtain fresh sourced market data and private PF state.
